rationale: Slice 4 implements the first clean-room causal mechanism tournament for sparse-conditional-routing. The experiment compares DENSE_ALL_SPECIALISTS, RANDOM_TOP_K, and CAPABILITY_ROUTED_TOP_K under an equal processing_resource_units=2 budget across two regimes (separable and ambiguous). The frozen, content-addressed experiment_contract and experiment_receipt are materialized. The local scientific decision is SUPPORTED_LOCAL: capability routing outperforms both dense and random baselines in both regimes under equal budget. However, this is a LOCAL result only — truth_effect=NONE and assimilation_effect=NONE. The mechanism remains at A1_MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS. A heterogeneous transfer test with independently implemented resources is required before any assimilation claim. Constitution/architecture-library/policy snapshots are unchanged; no canonical mutation occurred.
